Chapter 147: A More Powerful Competitor Appears

Chen Guiliang announced on the spot: "Due to Xie Yang's outstanding performance, we're rewarding him with a five-digit QQ number, and he'll have a share in the company's future option pool! There's no need for other colleagues to be envious. As long as you work hard, you will be rewarded. We are at a critical stage..."

President Chen was giving another pep talk.

The youth of today were still quite easy to dupe, unlike those twenty years later who had all started 'lying flat'.

They were quickly riled up, filled with fighting spirit, and threw themselves back into their work with passion.

Show-off Xie, his head still in the clouds, returned to his workstation to continue the battle. Over the two days of Saturday and Sunday, he had only crippled the 5Q Campus Net, not yet completely finished it off.

Moreover, continuing the relentless assault now could also attract more users to Xiaonei.

After all, only about 20,000 users from 5Q Campus Net had switched to Xiaonei over the weekend. Although there was some user overlap, attracting another 40,000 shouldn't be a problem.

Xie Yang logged into QQ and contacted the online campaign leaders to assemble.

He then discovered that two of the leaders had left messages: "Bro, we don't want the final payment, and we won't compete with you. Someone else made a higher offer for us to help with their promotion."

Xie Yang was completely baffled and replied: "Who?"

The two online campaign leaders quickly sent him a URL.

Another new competitor!

Xie Yang hadn't taken it seriously at first. Xiaonei's wings were already fully fledged; anyone entering the field now could only watch in frustration.

But as he browsed more posts and checked the public information released by the other party, Xie Yang realized this newly emerged website was extremely tricky.

"Chen Daxia, come take a look, quick!" Xie Yang was so anxious he directly used the nickname.

Chen Guiliang approached with a smile. "What's wrong?"

Xie Yang explained, "While we were beating down 5Q Campus Net, a website called Zhanzuo.com took the opportunity to promote itself. This site has been in preparation for at least two months, and all its functions are very mature."

Chen Guiliang pulled over an office chair and sat down.

Xie Yang continued, "The boss is named Zhang Fan, a Tsinghua undergrad, Harvard master's, and he also did his Ph.D. at Yale. eYou is his company. His eYou cooperates with over 800 universities and colleges nationwide. Many official organizations like the National People's Congress, the Beijing Municipal Education Commission, and the State Administration of Radio, Film, and Television, as well as 80 large corporations like GM, Haier Group, and Minsheng Bank, are all using eYou's email and management software."

This was all public information and also the focus of eYou's own publicity.

Xie Yang went on: "The major university BBS forums across the country are requiring real-name registration, and management is about to be forcibly taken over by the university authorities. The site administrators of those BBS forums have been resigning one after another, and some of them have already joined Zhanzuo.com. For example, this Vice President of Product, Xie Wei, is one of the original founders of the Tsinghua BBS. Moderators from many university BBS forums all made a move this morning, using their personal connections at their respective schools to attract students to register for Zhanzuo.com!"

"Also, many students have eYou email accounts, and these can also be converted into Zhanzuo.com users."

"I had two email accounts in high school, one was NetEase, the other was eYou. If I didn't know you, I might very well have registered for Zhanzuo.com because of eYou."

Chen Guiliang carefully read the public information and muttered, "This is even tougher to deal with than 5Q Campus Net."

In the other timeline, eYou's Zhang Fan had also entered the field, likewise jumping in after seeing Xiaonei's success. By then, Xiaonei already held an absolute advantage, yet they managed to grow despite the immense pressure.

However, by the time Zhanzuo.com grew large, the second wave of the internet boom was already nearing its end. As a result, venture capitalists only recognized the number one player and were unwilling to invest in the number two. On top of that, with QQ Campus stirring the pot, Zhanzuo.com eventually shut down due to a lack of funding and pressure from the top.

Zhanzuo.com, having entered the scene early due to Chen Guiliang's influence, was truly a formidable opponent, especially since eYou's email service had not yet completely declined.

Moreover, eYou had also taken advantage of the real-name registration on university BBS forums to pull in a bunch of resentfully resigned BBS administrators to help with promotion!

For instance, one of the original founders of the Tsinghua BBS had become Zhanzuo.com's Vice President of Product.

These BBS administrators had extensive personal networks at their respective universities, making them far more effective than the on-the-ground promoters 5Q Campus Net had used.

Chen Guiliang was a little annoyed: Damn it, why didn't I preemptively register the name Zhanzuo.com?

Chen Guiliang thought it over carefully. "The most urgent task right now is to increase user stickiness, to prevent those BBS administrators from luring our users away. *Happy Farm* will need at least another half a month before its closed beta. We need to run an event quickly. This half-month period is crucial. If we run the event well, we might even be able to strangle Zhanzuo.com in its cradle!"

"Another campus belle contest?" Xie Yang asked.

Chen Guiliang said, "We can't hold the campus belle contest too frequently, or it will annoy the users. We can pick a day in mid-October and designate it as the 'Campus Belle Festival'. At that time of year, the new students will have been at school for over a month, and the National Day holiday will be over, making it the perfect time to select a campus belle."

Xie Yang racked his brain but couldn't come up with any good ideas.

"Call a company-wide meeting!"

Aside from the warehouse manager and Taobao shop owner for the Legends of the Three Kingdoms physical cards, all 20 other employees gathered together.

Chen Guiliang asked, "Who here has used eYou's email service?"

More than half the employees in the company raised their hands.

This was because over 80% of the nation's universities and colleges, including Tsinghua, Peking University, Fudan, and others, officially used eYou's email service. This was especially true for university faculty and staff; almost every one of them had an eYou account.

eYou had also launched an anti-spam engine with a spam interception rate of up to 98%, which was highly favored by government, university, and corporate users. It would even be selected as one of "China's Top Ten Independently Innovative Software Products" this year.

Chen Guiliang said, "Our next opponent is eYou. They've just launched Zhanzuo.com."

"It's really eYou?"

Many employees were very surprised, and Ao Yanchen exclaimed aloud.

Chen Guiliang smiled. "Although the enemy is strong, we already have a significant head start. I need to organize an event to retain users as much as possible within the next two weeks. Does anyone have any good ideas?"

Qi Yongsi, a programmer who had joined last month, raised his hand. "The Champions League has entered the round of 16. We could organize a betting event, letting Xiaonei users guess the match outcomes. We could also hold a campus soccer photo contest, encouraging users to upload pictures of themselves playing soccer."

"That's a good idea," Chen Guiliang said. "Any others?"

Gong Xiaozhen, who had been Photoshopped into a prank picture with Xie Yang, raised her hand. "We could have a 'Campus Kiss' event, encouraging couples to take pictures of themselves kissing, and then let users vote on which photo is the most romantic."

As she said this, all her colleagues turned to look at her.

Gong Xiaozhen asked awkwardly, "Is there something wrong with that?"

Chen Guiliang said, "We might get reported for being pornographic."

"Kissing doesn't count as porn, does it?" Gong Xiaozhen said weakly.

Ao Yanchen said, "Every March, Peking University's May Fourth Society holds the Weiming Poetry Festival. Why don't we organize a Xiaonei Poetry Festival too?"

Chen Guiliang said, "We can do that, but the participation level might not be very high. We need to attract the broader student population to join in."

Xie Yang had been sitting at his workstation the whole time, monitoring posts on major forums and BBS, and occasionally checking Zhanzuo.com for updates.

Suddenly, Xie Yang cried out, "Holy shit!"

"What's wrong?" Chen Guiliang asked.

Xie Yang said, "Zhanzuo.com barely has any users, yet they're already launching an event. And what's more, the organizers are the Communist Youth League and the China Youth Daily, with Zhanzuo.com as the exclusive host. The event is called 'I Advance with My Motherland: Seeking China's University Students of Self-Reliance'. The entire selection process is supported by online voting. The event will last until the end of the year, encouraging university students to find moving stories around them, and to present and shape a positive image of contemporary university students who are brave enough to take responsibility and face difficulties."

Everyone fell silent, the pressure mounting.
